_blessed_against: a freshly seeded stack (CI's contract job). A developer volume that has drifted from a fresh seed will disagree — that disagreement is a true statement about the volume, not about the fixtures.

_context.fixture-defect: the recording is wrong — this is work
_context.post-fault: the scenario seeds a fault and the check probes the un-faulted world; not a defect and must not be 'fixed'
_context.post-action: the fixture element records the world after the agent's own remediation and the check probes the world before it; unfixable by construction and must not be 'fixed'
_context.canned-only: the scenario never runs live, so its recordings are its premise rather than a recording of anything
